meta.name: English
app.title: MikkiLens — Settings
tabs.label: Settings pages
status.heading: Status
status.listenNowHint: The same as pressing the hotkey.
status.stopStreamConfirm: Press again to stop the stream
status.engineUnreachable: The MikkiLens engine is not answering. {detail}
audio.heading: Audio
audio.outputHint: This is where MikkiLens speaks. Press Test to hear it.
audio.sttHint: A bigger model hears you better and uses more memory. small is the balance MikkiLens ships with; base mishears short commands often enough to be worth leaving behind. Changing either of these reloads recognition, which takes a few seconds.
audio.sttAuto: The graphics card, if there is one
audio.chatHint: Chat is read for hours at a time, so it usually wants to sit under the confirmations rather than over them.
audio.sampleText: Hello, this is what MikkiLens sounds like.
commands.heading: Commands
commands.hint: If a command is often misheard, add the misheard text as another phrase. That is the fastest fix.
connections.heading: Connections
youtube.hint: Chat needs no setup at all. Connecting adds the viewer count, the stream title, and changing the title by voice.
youtube.connecting: Opening the YouTube sign-in page in your browser. Agree there, then come back; this can take a minute.
youtube.disconnected: YouTube is disconnected. The sign-in has been removed from this machine.
youtube.notConnected: Not connected. Press Connect YouTube; it opens one page in your browser and only has to be done once.
youtube.noClient: There is no YouTube sign-in set up on this machine. Download OAuth desktop credentials from Google Cloud and save them as data/client_secret.json, then press Connect YouTube.
channels.hint: Each channel pairs an OBS profile with a YouTube sign-in. Switching moves both at once, so a broadcast never goes out on one channel with another channel's chat read over it. Say “switch channel to music” to change channel by voice.
channels.none: No channels yet. Connect one to get started.
channels.obsOffline: OBS is not connected, so the profile lists are empty.
channels.name: What to call it
channels.needsSignIn: Not signed in. Press Connect another channel and pick this one.
channels.connecting: Opening the browser. Choose the channel to connect, then come back.
model.hint: One endpoint compatible with OpenAI, used for everything: summarising chat, working out commands it did not recognise, and describing your screen. Because of that last one, pick a model that can see images.
model.matcherLabel: Use it to work out commands it did not recognise
model.matcherHint: With this on, anything none of your written phrases match is sent to the model above. Everything that already matches stays instant and is never sent.
language.heading: Language
language.wakeHint: How sure it has to be before it answers. Lower it if she does not answer you; raise it if it triggers while you are talking to chat. The bars below show what it is hearing right now.
language.wakeNoModels: There are no wake word models in data/models, so only the hotkey works. Put an openWakeWord .onnx file there.
language.wakeNotInstalled: “{model}” is not in data/models, so nothing is listening for it. Choose one that is installed, or put its .onnx file there.
language.wakeRuntimeMissing: The wake word needs the ONNX runtime: {reason}
language.wakeFailed: The wake word could not start: {reason}
language.micSilent: The microphone is open but hearing nothing.
language.micHearing: Hearing you. The wake word has not matched yet.
language.wakeSwitchedOff: Hearing you. The wake word is switched off.
language.wakeNotRunning: Hearing you, but the wake word is not running.
language.wakeBusy: Listening to a command right now.
language.hotkeyPrompt: Press the keys you want to use. Escape cancels.
language.hotkeyCaptured: Hotkey set to {combination}. Press Save to use it.
language.hotkeyUnchanged: The hotkey was left as it was.
language.hotkeyNeedsModifier: Hold ctrl, alt, shift or the Windows key as well: a key on its own would be taken away from every other application.
language.hotkeyUnusableKey: {key} cannot be used as a hotkey. Try a letter, a number or a function key.
language.hotkeyRefused: Windows would not give MikkiLens that key: {reason}
language.hotkeyHint: Press Change, then press the keys themselves.
log.heading: Log
log.hint: What MikkiLens heard and what it said. This page is the most useful one when a command is not working.
log.caption: History of what MikkiLens said
update.ready: MikkiLens {version} is ready to install. Open the menu and choose Install the update when you are not live.
update.readyPortable: MikkiLens {version} is available. This copy cannot update itself, so download the new one when you have a moment.
update.installing: Installing MikkiLens {version}. It will start again by itself.
update.notWhileLive: You are live, so the update will wait. Ask again after the stream.
update.portable: This copy cannot update itself. Download MikkiLens {version} to replace it.
donations.hint: Chat stops being read while a donation alert is on screen, so nothing talks over it.
donations.readAloudWarning: If you turn reading aloud on, switch the overlay’s own voice off in the Tako or Trakteer dashboard — otherwise every donation is read twice at once.
donations.maxGiftRecipientsHint: When somebody gifts memberships in bulk, read this many names and then “and 45 others”. Zero reads every one.
